Commentary of King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 114, verse 1:

Naming of the Surah

• It is called "Al-Nas" (The People), due to the mention of the word "al-nas" in it, repeated five times.

From the Objectives of the Surah

• Affirming the two forms of Tawhid, that of Lordship (tawhid al-rububiyyah) and that of Divinity (tawhid al-uluhiyyah), by teaching the Prophet and his community, and training them, to take refuge in Allah and to seek His protection, so that He may suffice them against the evil of the devils of mankind and jinn, who whisper to them, adorning for them the path of evil.

[The Tafsir]

Say, O Messenger: "I seek refuge and protection in the Lord of mankind, the One alone able to repel the evil of the whisperer."
The Sovereign of mankind, who disposes of all their affairs, the One who is free of need from them.
Ilāh al-nās (the God of mankind), the One besides whom there is no true deity worthy of worship.

from the evil of the whisperer who slinks away, the one who whispers into the hearts of people, (Qur'an 114:4)? Wait—I need to translate only the given text.

Translation:

"From the evil of the whisperer, who whispers when people are heedless, and who withdraws (hides) when Allah is remembered."
"The one who whispers evil and doubts into the breasts of people."
From the devils among the jinn and mankind.
